author: Aad, Georges and others
title: Search for charged-lepton-flavour violation in Z-boson decays with the ATLAS detector
abstract: A search for Z-boson decays into a tau lepton and another lepton of different flavour using 139 fb-1 at sqrt(s)=13 TeV and 20.3 fb-1 at sqrt(s)=8 TeV. Upper limits at 95% CL for the branching fractions: B(Z->e tau) < 8.1e-6, B(Z->mu tau) < 9.5e-6 (combined Run 1+Run 2).
